note: No threshold is chosen here and none is applied anywhere. Each window carries the weakest of its three frames, because a window is only as watchable as its worst moment.
purpose: Candidate local-focus measures on the same 92 windows the readability calibration measured and labelled. No search, no new footage: each source was fetched by provider id and the same sampled positions re-decoded.
no_threshold_applied: Nothing here is gated on. window_sharpness remains the only quality number choose_window uses, and it is still only a tie-break.
